R48748.name: Kevin Hanick
details: Whenever I'm at my local grocery stores, I see discounts on all types of Camels, except the Camel straights (N.F.).
I've smoked Camel (N.F.) for 20 years and very much enjoy them.
It just "gets my goat" when they get a break when I have to pay full price! Where is the parity?
I'd like to find out. Any help would be much appreciated.
